title: Max Points on a Line
description:
Given an array of points where points[i] = [x i , y i ] represents a point on the X-Y plane, return the maximum number of points that lie on the same straight line . 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/02/25/plane1.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 points = [[1,1],[2,2],[3,3]]

Output:
 3
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/02/25/plane2.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 points = [[1,1],[3,2],[5,3],[4,1],[2,3],[1,4]]

Output:
 4
```

 Constraints: 

 1 <= points.length <= 300 
 
 points[i].length == 2 
 
 -10 4 <= x i , y i <= 10 4 
 
 All the points are unique .
